Chapter 6945: Destroy This Realm To Appease You

Chapter 6945: Destroy This Realm To Appease You

Some had an illusion that Breaker Immortal was a reasonable person. Of course, others shook their head and smiled wryly.

Breaker was a bastard who would destroy worlds after a minor disagreement. He only acted with reason when facing someone stronger. The problem was that this was an exclusive group.

“I wanted to destroy your branch and coincidentally enough, your son captured my people. That gives me a better reason to do so.” Li Qiye chuckled.

The revelation made the crowd ponder. Sure, that would be a perfect reason.

“Your people?” Breaker glanced at Treasure Immortal Lord.

“I’ve returned them, perfectly unharmed.” The latter became startled and said, clearly afraid of his violent father.

“Is that not enough, Sir?” Breaker asked.

“What do you think?” Li Qiye responded.

“This bastard has committed so many atrocities. Sir, kill him and obliterate this realm to appease your anger.” Breaker’s expression soured.

“What?!” The crowd became slack-jawed upon hearing this.

Sects always defended their own, and parents did so even more. Even if their children had done something heinous, they would still be defended. The blame would be shifted somehow.

However, Breaker had a different idea, ready to abandon his son. Remember, his son’s branch also included many descendants.

Most importantly, Treasure seemed to be Breaker’s only living son. This meant the end of his lineage.

“Father!” Treasure shouted.

“You deserve death for causing this disaster.” Breaker uttered coldly. He turned toward Li Qiye and said: “Sir, would you like to do it or would you like me to?”

Treasure staggered backward, pale. Normally, immortals were emotionless since their loved ones and friends had died long ago. This didn’t apply to this case.

When Treasure was born, his father was already a primordial immortal. He cultivated to catch up and lived just as long.

“Very good, such decisiveness is admirable.” Li Qiye clapped.

“Is it enough to quell your anger, Sir?” Breaker said.

“You misunderstood something. I was never angry in the first place, and nothing you do can change the destruction of your branch.” Li Qiye shook his head.

Everyone took a deep breath. Earlier, they witnessed Li Qiye’s power. However, would it be effective against a primordial immortal?

Breaker gazed intensely at Li Qiye, causing cracks to appear in the firmament.

“It’s starting.” Immortals could tell Breaker had had enough.

“Which world are you from, Sir?” Breaker asked.

“You want to destroy my world? That’s fine, I’m from the nine worlds.” Li Qiye smiled.

Breaker’s eyes narrowed upon hearing this.

“It’s true.” Many immortals have speculated this previously.

Long ago, these worlds were ant nests in their eyes, not worth mentioning. Now, so many immortals from Guardian Alliance came from these worlds.

Moreover, Breaker couldn’t destroy the nine worlds either.

“Only the high heaven can destroy the nine worlds.” Others read his expression perfectly.

Heavenrealm had its own space and time; the nine worlds were not part of it. Sure, an immortal could pay an incalculable price to reach the nine worlds. Not to mention the grievous injuries, their cultivation might no longer be in the immortal realm.
